method: manual review against the Section 4.3.2 ValidFunc rule
principle: a validation function must reference validated access-control state and enforce denial in the controlled branch

functions.name: check_forum_password
functions.rationale: Validates the forum-password cookie and propagates the failed decision through $showform to a terminating branch.

functions.name: check_forum_password_archive
functions.rationale: Checks the forum-password cookie and directly invokes the archive denial routine in the rejecting branch.
